title: From Citations to Contributions: LLM-Assisted Credit Scoring of Research Articles
abstract: arXiv:2609.07673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Citation-based measures of scientific influence typically treat citations as uniform signals, ignoring the different roles that cited works play in a paper's contribution. We introduce contribution-based credit scoring for research articles: a structured citation analysis that decomposes a paper's credit between its own original contribution and the prior work it builds on. Motivated by a cooperative-game view of scientific credit, we propose the contribution tree, a hierarchical framework that conserves importance across the document structure and separates original from citation-derived contribution. To make this framework scalable, we use LLMs as noisy comparative estimators of local importance. translated_title: 从引用到贡献：基于大语言模型辅助的科研论文贡献度评分
translated_abstract: 基于引用的学术影响力衡量指标通常将所有引用视为统一的信号，忽略了被引文献在论文贡献中所扮演的不同角色。我们提出了针对科研论文的基于贡献的功劳评分方法：一种结构化的引用分析框架，将论文的功劳在其自身原创贡献与所依赖的前人工作之间进行分解。受科学功劳分配的合作博弈论视角启发，我们提出了“贡献树”概念——这是一个在文档结构上保持重要性守恒的层次化框架，能够将原创贡献与引用派生的贡献分离开来。为了使该框架具备可扩展性，我们使用大语言模型作为局部重要性的含噪声比较估计器。我们进一步将该模型扩展到论文集合层面，通过加权引用图传播贡献，从而得到语料库级别的贡献度与归一化的影响力评分。我们的实验表明，该框架能够有效捕捉论文的贡献结构。
tldr: 提出了一种大语言模型辅助的“贡献树”框架，通过结构化引用分析将论文功劳在其原创贡献与前人工作之间进行分解，并可通过加权引用图传播扩展至语料库级别的影响力评分。
en_tdlr: Proposes an LLM-assisted contribution tree framework that decomposes scientific credit between a paper's original contributions and the prior work it builds on, scalable to corpus-level influence scoring via weighted citation graph propagation.
